one_sentence_story: In 1935, J. Ridley Stroop proved that naming the ink color of mismatched color words ('RED' printed in blue) slows literate humans by 74% because decades of automatic reading hijack speech unless anterior cingulate and prefrontal control actively brake the word.
so_what_for_you: Never design habits, dashboards, or safety buttons where an automatic cue (color or habit) fights the intended label — align visual cues WITH automatic reflexes instead of burning prefrontal willpower all day.
